verdict.rationale: Osborne Clarke is a law firm selling legal advisory services, not a software platform, so asking whether it offers official SDKs is a category error. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any developer SDK or API, and the openapi probes all returned 404. The only digital offerings documented are an online investor-readiness check, downloadable cap table templates and a UPC decision tracker site, none of which are SDKs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
